title: Figure 1 in Saccharomyces cerevisiae OS303 expression of an alkaline protease from a newly isolated Bacillus subtilis D9
author: Alqosaibi, A. I.
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0
materials: DNA size marker hyperladder I; Lane

steps.title: Run PCR product on gel
steps.instruction: After PCR, load 5 µL of the product onto a 1 % agarose gel, run electrophoresis, and verify the appearance of an approximately 1300 bp band; lane 1 should contain the DNA size marker Hyperladder I and lane 2 the PCR sample.

substeps.instruction: Load 5 µL of the PCR product into lane 2 of the 1 % agarose gel.
Load the DNA size marker Hyperladder I into lane 1.
Run the gel electrophoresis under appropriate conditions.
Visualize the gel and confirm a band near 1300 bp in lane 2.
